title: Art Hero Identity
description: Art-direction identity of a humanoid hero (data/art/heroes/<group>/<slug>.json). Name, sex, element, race and class are NOT stored here -- they are pulled from the gameplay card named by cardId. Only look (palette, physique) lives here. A hero with no card (test-bed) sets testBed:true and carries its own name.

allOf.$comment: Female card heroes need signature cosmetic colours; test beds (no cardId, reference-photo driven) are exempt.

cardId.description: Link to the gameplay card (data/cards/**). The card's art.artIdentity must point back at this file.

testBed.description: True for calibration heroes with no gameplay card

name.description: Only for testBed heroes; card-linked heroes take name from the card

defaultUnderlayer.description: A-pose underlayer piece used when a pose card sets none (the hero's signature look); override per card with components.underlayer

defaultFootwear.description: A-pose shoe piece (legs_feet) filling {{FOOTWEAR}} inside the swimwear pieces; override per card with components.footwear

defaultSheen.description: Surface-finish piece (wardrobe/finishes/*.json) filling {{SHEEN}} inside metallic pieces; override per card with components.sheen

hairColor.description: Base hair colour only; highlights come from hairHighlights

metal.description: The hero's signature metal (e.g. 'platinum'); feeds {{METAL}} in the metallic underlayer

nailColor.description: Fingernail and toenail colour ({{NAIL}}); default is 'Light <last word of primaryColor>'

lipColor.description: Signature lip tint ({{LIP}}), used as 'subtle <lipColor>-tinted satin'; default berry

eyeshadowColor.description: Signature eyeshadow tone ({{EYESHADOW}}); default is the last word of the first accent colour

lashColor.description: Natural lash colour ({{LASH}}), aligned to the hair; default black. Override per scene (overrides.palette) to make lashes pop

browColor.description: Natural brow colour ({{BROW}}), aligned to the hair; default unspecified. Override per scene (overrides.palette) to make brows pop

magicColor.description: Signature spell/energy/glow colour ({{MAGIC}}): eye glow, weapon light, scene effects; default is the last word of the first accent

gemColor.description: Signature gemstone ({{GEM}}) used in jewelry, e.g. 'aquamarine'; default is the last word of the first accent

hairHighlights.description: Highlight-style piece (cosmetics/highlights/<family>/*.json); its {{HIGHLIGHT_COLOR}} is filled from hairHighlightColor

hairStyleComponent.description: Path to the default A-pose hairstyle piece
